summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the repository, without running tests, mypy, or Black and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, gated on is_terminal, with a Google-style docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title; CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200; tests added in test_control.py, test_console.py (forced terminal, skipped on legacy Windows), and test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only, mocked set_title). Everything was verified by reading only. The console test uses the file's existing early-return skip pattern rather than pytest.skip.
